title: MissingReferenceException: The object of type 'UnityEngine.Material' has been destroyed but you are still trying to acce
notes: Fix 2026-11-20 by claude (c0ef0c8281): UIThemeLive.SwapSea read Graphic.material on a TMP sub-mesh, whose getter clones the shared material and throws when that material was destroyed with its font fallback. It reads the sub-mesh's sharedMaterial now.
